title: BLDC six-step commutation: alignment, ripple, efficiency and cascade control
algorithm: Six-step commutation with Hall sectors; PI and cascade PI speed control
plant_model: Averaged-PWM BLDC, trapezoidal back-EMF, ideal commutation (RK4, 20 us)

status.software: Executed from a clean kernel; local unit tests passed at build time; GitHub Actions has not been run on this repository

limitations: Ideal commutation: commutation current transient and the resulting torque dip are not modelled.
Averaged PWM, no dead time, switch drops, iron loss or mutual inductance.
Trapezoid as clipped sine; real back-EMF shapes differ.

checks.name: aligned: f_h - f_l = 2 at every angle (3600 angles, all six sectors visited)
trapezoid_shape: flat top 120 deg wide, value 2 sin(theta) on the slope
steady-state speed equals the closed-form value (<0.1%)
steady-state pair current equals (Tl + B w)/kt (<0.5%)
energy balance: D Vdc I = 2 R I^2 + kt w I (<0.5%)
single loop draws more than 2x the 6 A limit at start
cascade keeps the pair current within 15% of the limit
A single-loop PI: steady-state speed error below 0.5%
B cascade: steady-state speed error below 0.5%
open loop, constant duty: torque ripple equals the commutation-granularity floor (sqrt3/2) p w dt within 10%
ideal trapezoid, aligned, closed loop: torque ripple within 10% of the same floor
narrower flat top (80 deg) gives more torque ripple than 120 deg at zero offset
efficiency falls as Hall offset grows (120 deg flat: 0 > 10 > 20 degrees)
